import ctypes

def allocate_buffer(size):
    # Allocate a buffer of the specified size using ctypes
    return ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)

def read_and_print_buffer():
    # Allocate a 1024-byte buffer
    buf = allocate_buffer(1024)
    
    # Read 10 characters from standard input
    input_data = input()[:10]  # Take at most 10 characters
    
    # Store the input in the buffer
    buf.raw = input_data.encode('utf-8')
    
    # Print the buffer content
    print(buf.raw.decode('utf-8'))

# Call the function
read_and_print_buffer()

import ctypes

def allocate_buffer(size):
    """分配指定大小的内存缓冲区"""
    return ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)

def read_input_to_buffer(buf):
    """从标准输入读取10个字符并存储到缓冲区"""
    input_str = input()[:10]  # 读取输入并限制为10个字符
    buf.raw = input_str.encode('utf-8')  # 将字符串编码并写入缓冲区

    """将缓冲区内容打印到标准输出"""
    print(buf.raw.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))

    buf = allocate_buffer(1024)
    
    # 从标准输入读取10个字符并存储
    read_input_to_buffer(buf)

def read_from_stdin():
    # Read 10 characters from standard input and store in buffer

    # Ensure we don't exceed buffer size
    buffer[:len(input_data)] = input_data.encode('utf-8')

    # Print the characters stored in buffer
    # Find the first null byte or up to 10 characters

        if buffer[i] == 0:

        print(chr(buffer[i]), end='')

import sys

def read_and_print_buffer():
    # Aloca um buffer de 1024 bytes
    buffer = bytearray(1024)
    
    # Lê 10 caracteres do input padrão
    input_data = sys.stdin.read(10)
    
    # Verifica se há mais dados disponíveis
    if len(input_data) < 10:
        # Se menos de 10 caracteres foram lidos, pode ser o final do input
        buffer[:len(input_data)] = input_data.encode('utf-8')
    else:
        # Se exatamente 10 caracteres foram lidos, copia para o buffer
        buffer[:10] = input_data.encode('utf-8')
    
    # Chama a função que imprime o buffer
    print_buffer(buffer)

def print_buffer(buf):
    # Imprime o conteúdo do buffer até o primeiro caractere nulo (ou até o tamanho do buffer)
    print(buf[:buf.find(b'\x00')].decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))

# Chama a função principal
read_and_print_buffer()

import ctypes

def allocate_buffer():
    # 1024バイトのメモリを割り当てる
    buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(1024)
    return buffer

def read_and_store():
    # 標準入力から10文字を読み取る
    user_input = input()[:10]  # 最大10文字まで取得
    return user_input

def main():
    # バッファを割り当てる
    buf = allocate_buffer()
    
    # 10文字を読み取り、バッファに格納
    data = read_and_store()
    buf.raw = data.encode('utf-8')  # バイト列に変換して格納
    
    # バッファの内容を出力
    print(buf.raw.decode('utf-8'))

if __name__ == "__main__":
